detailed_summary.overall_summary: A customer calls the electricity office to complain about a power outage at his home that hasn't been fixed for 2-3 days, despite previous reports. The agent claims technicians visited the day before but left because no one answered the doorbell. The customer points out the logical fallacy: the electric doorbell doesn't work because there is no power. The call ends with the customer becoming verbally abusive towards the office staff.
detailed_summary.foul_language_details: The customer used the Malayalam slur 'naayinte mone' (son of a dog/bitch) directed at the employees.

agents_analysis.behavior: The agent remained calm and professional in tone. However, he displayed a significant lack of practical logic by justifying the technician's failure to resolve the issue because the electric calling bell wasn't answered during a power outage.
agents_analysis.rating: 4/10, because while he was polite, the reasoning provided for the service failure was incompetent and frustrated the customer further.

customer_analysis.genuineness: The customer's issue appears genuine as he provides specific location details (near the Anganwadi) and points out a very logical flaw in the agent's story.
customer_analysis.behavior: Initially frustrated and complaining, the customer becomes sarcastically angry when he realizes the technician tried to use an electric bell during an outage. He eventually loses his temper and uses foul language.
customer_analysis.satisfaction_level: Very Dissatisfied, as his power issue remains unresolved and he feels the service department is incompetent.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Ithu matte electrical... electricity office? Njan matte panchayathinte aduth oru anganwadi ille?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Aa anganwadite thotta veedanu. Njan oru randu moonu divasam munne vilichunnu. Veetil mathram current illa, bakki ellayidathum current undu. Athonnu vannu nokkan paranjittu ningal ithuvare vannillalo. Entha ithu?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Ningal vilichu paranjittundayirunnu, randu divasam munne.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Innale aaru vannu? Current illa ippozhum veettilo!

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Innale vannittu ippo orupaadu thavana calling bell adichu. Pakshe ningal aarum purathu vannilla.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Aa... bell adichittu karyamilla. Bell work cheyyilla. Current ille? Current undayirunnalle bell work cheyyullu!

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Ippo current illa ennu paranjittu thanne alle ningale vilichu varuthiyathu? Ningal ethu naayinte mone aanu pani eduthe... thenga!
